comment: Current-main noise floor for npc-day-parity: zero. Full days of one build are byte-identical on dev-ubuntu, on Ryzen and between them (2026-11-07, seed 73106; docs/world-streaming.md, the animation LOD phase section). Before that fix ASLR gave every process its own LOD stagger, so days of one build could differ. Branch Full and Simplified with OPENGOTHIC_NPC_SIMPLE_MOVE=0 must retain exact gameplay journals; require_journal_identical compares every nonhero sample field except the diagnostic tier and every nonhero event, including final events beyond the last scheduled sample. The completeness gates also reject truncated runs and missing NPCs. Only active Simplified/auto use the separately accepted 6c approximation profile.
